failure.original_error: Circular shift escaped its valid segment

cause: IEEE754 float64 addition a+mod(local,duration) can round to excluded upper endpoint b despite residue strictly smaller than duration.
allowed_correction: Only a computed shifted value exactly equal to its own segment stop b may be replaced with nextafter(b,a), the greatest representable in-segment value. Require finite positive segment duration and residue in [0,duration). All other escaping/nonfinite values remain errors.
forbidden: Do not wrap upper-end roundoff to segment start
